hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template K(n)*q(n) by replacing the parameter q with the function symbol a to obtain K(n)*a(n), and with b to obtain K(n)*b(n). The raw expression is the sum of these two instantiations.
required_assumptions: K(n), a(n), and b(n) are defined for the declared symbol n
The two product terms are generated from the same template and then summed
hypotheses.rationale: Both non-identical terms share the same multiplicative factor K(n), so they can be viewed as specializations of a single product template K(n)*q(n) with q replaced by the two different function symbols a and b.
